_meta.note: The deal ledger — dated, sourced records behind every capital/compute flow. Citations point to the announcing party or primary press coverage; domain-level URLs are used where a deep link could not be verified. verify:true = terms reported but not fully confirmed. Amounts in USD billions as announced/reported.

deals.headline: Microsoft extends OpenAI partnership — third investment round
deals.notes: Follows the 2019 ($1B) and 2021 rounds; cumulative commitment widely reported ≈$13B. Partnership restructured 2025 with revised revenue-share and IP terms.

deals.headline: NVIDIA letter of intent: up to $100B invested progressively alongside 10GW of systems
deals.notes: Phased investment tied to gigawatt-scale deployments of NVIDIA systems; structure (LOI, tranches per GW) reported at announcement. The canonical circular-financing exhibit.

citations.title: NVIDIA and OpenAI announce strategic partnership

deals.headline: SoftBank leads $40B round at $300B post-money; SoftBank portion ≈$30B
deals.notes: Largest private round on record at announcement; SoftBank portion subject to tranche conditions. OpenAI valuation later marked ≈$500B in secondary sales (Oct 2025).

deals.headline: Amazon completes $8B total investment in Anthropic
deals.notes: $4B (Sep 2023) + $4B (Nov 2024); AWS named primary cloud & training partner; Trainium commitment deepened.

deals.headline: Google commits up to $2B (2023), building on earlier ~$550M stake; total ≈$3B+
deals.notes: Convertible structure reported; separate from the 2025 TPU capacity expansion (see compute deal).

citations.title: Google agrees to invest up to $2 billion in Anthropic

deals.headline: Anthropic expands to up to one million Google TPUs
deals.notes: Multi-gigawatt TPU capacity coming online through 2026; reported as tens of billions of dollars of committed capacity.

citations.title: Expanding our use of Google Cloud TPUs

deals.headline: OpenAI–Oracle ≈$300B, ~5-year cloud compute agreement (Stargate)
deals.notes: Reported alongside Oracle's RPO jump to ≈$455B in Sep 2025 earnings; part of the broader Stargate buildout with Abilene TX flagship site.

citations.title: OpenAI, Oracle sign $300 billion cloud deal

deals.headline: OpenAI–CoreWeave compute contracts: $11.9B initial, expanded to ≈$22.4B
deals.notes: Initial five-year agreement (March 2025, incl. ~$350M equity to OpenAI) with subsequent expansions through 2025.

deals.headline: NVIDIA equity stake plus $6.3B cloud-capacity backstop order
deals.notes: NVIDIA holds an equity position from earlier rounds; Sep 2025 filing disclosed an order guaranteeing purchase of unsold capacity through 2032.

deals.headline: Microsoft–Nebius GPU capacity deal: $17.4B over ~5 years (expandable to $19.4B)
deals.notes: Capacity from Nebius's Vineland NJ data center; one of the defining neocloud contracts.

deals.headline: OpenAI to deploy 6GW of AMD Instinct GPUs; AMD grants warrant for up to 160M shares
deals.notes: Warrant (~10% of AMD) vests in tranches tied to deployment milestones and share-price targets; first 1GW on MI450 series. Reported as tens of billions in expected revenue.

citations.title: AMD and OpenAI announce strategic partnership

deals.headline: ASML leads Mistral AI's €1.7B Series C with ≈€1.3B (~$1.5B), taking ~11%
deals.notes: Round valued Mistral ≈€11.7B post-money; the equipment chokepoint buying into the European model lab.

deals.headline: Figure's $675M Series B — NVIDIA, Microsoft, OpenAI Startup Fund, Bezos among investors
deals.notes: Valued Figure ≈$2.6B then; Figure later raised at ≈$39B (Sep 2025 Series C led by Parkway).

deals.headline: NVIDIA participates in Nebius $700M private placement
deals.notes: Alongside Accel and Orbis; NVIDIA equity position in the neocloud tier.
